meaning: Produces clear questions and hypotheses that can be investigated. Research should be capable of refining the account, not merely illustrating it.
Allows observations that could count against a specific prediction. Being falsifiable does not mean already disproved; explaining every possible outcome makes a claim difficult to test.
Connects findings into an intelligible explanation and accommodates new evidence. Breadth is useful only when the account explains differences rather than relabelling them.
Helps practitioners or researchers choose what to do and why. Practical usefulness and treatment effectiveness must still be evaluated independently.
Uses compatible assumptions, logically connected claims and clear definitions. Operational definitions specify how concepts will be observed or measured.
Uses no more assumptions or explanatory machinery than needed for adequate explanation. Simplicity is a comparison between accounts that explain the evidence sufficiently well.
